signals.name: Marvell Technology, Inc.
signals.label: Marvell's $115B all-stock bid for Lumentum just hit the tape on top of a quarter of broad institutional accumulation and a Congressional buying cluster -- even as its own insiders were selling into the run-up.
signals.detail: Marvell agreed Nov 2 2026 to acquire Lumentum in a fixed-ratio, all-stock deal originally valued near $115B for AI data-center optical/custom-silicon infrastructure; MRVL fell 12.72% on the day, shrinking the implied deal value to roughly $81B. The announcement followed fresh Q3 13F filings showing new MRVL stakes from several advisers (Oct 30-Nov 2) and a 2026 congressional buying cluster (Reps. Ro Khanna, Gilbert Cisneros, Byron Donalds). Insiders including EVP Sandeep Bharathi sold ~$11M via 10b5-1 plans in the trailing 90 days; WSB mentions spiked ~2,660% in 24h after the deal broke.
signals.takeaway: Institutions and Congress had been building Marvell ahead of the Lumentum bid, but insiders sold into the rally and the market's sharp negative reaction shows real skepticism about the all-stock terms.
